basic_info.description: Period charm meets Eurochic in this upper-market location. Welcome to this bright, stylish 2+ bed, 2-bath condo blending timeless details with sleek modern updates. The spacious layout features warm hardwood floors, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. The updated kitchen has quartz countertops, ample cabinetry, and generous counter space, ideal for cooking or entertaining. An adjacent dining area with a large window offers views of the lush backyard oasis. Both bedrooms provide comfort and privacy, while the bathrooms feature modern finishes that complement the home's classic character. A versatile bonus room can serve as a home office, nursery, or walk-in closet, providing flexible options. The formal living room includes a brick fireplace, large windows, and French doors, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The shared landscaped garden has a brick patio, mature palm trees, and built-in bench seating, offering a private outdoor retreat. Additional features include deeded basement storage, secured leased parking and storage, and low HOA dues. Located just steps from restaurants, shopping, and transit options like Bike Share, Church St. Muni, 16th St. BART, and freeways, this home provides excellent convenience. TransitScore 100 / WalkScore 99!
